evidence_required: a design with budget arithmetic, the decision rule, and the rejected alternative.

marking.criterion: Budget arithmetic: workloads fit 16 GPU-hours (e.g. 2 nodes × 8 GPUs × 1 h)
Node selection and stratification (same-node history, reference node)
Decision rule (permutation p < 0.05 and regression > max(A/A floor, 2 %) blocks; warn band)
A/A floor control under 1 % (dedicated nodes, persistence, warm-up, pinned containers, interleaving)
Rejected alternative defended (e.g. running on whichever production nodes are free)

title: Nightly performance-regression gate
